title: Dynamic Attribute Access
prompt:
Get object attribute value using string variable identifier dynamically.

Starting code:

class Config:
    port = 8080

attr_name = "port"
value = ___(Config, attr_name)
sample_solution:
class Config:
    port = 8080

attr_name = "port"
value = getattr(Config, attr_name)

title: Structural Pattern Matching
prompt:
Match dynamic status code structure using match / case.

Starting code:

status = 404
___ status:
    case 200:
        print("OK")
    case 404:
        print("Not Found")
sample_solution:
status = 404
match status:
    case 200:
        print("OK")
    case 404:
        print("Not Found")

title: Heapq Push and Pop
prompt:
Transform a list into a min-heap, push an item, and pop the smallest item.

Starting code:

import heapq

heap = [3, 1, 4]
heapq.___(heap)
heapq.___(heap, 2)
smallest = heapq.heappop(heap)
sample_solution:
import heapq

heap = [3, 1, 4]
heapq.heapify(heap)
heapq.heappush(heap, 2)
smallest = heapq.heappop(heap)
